title: NATURAL LANGUAGE UNDERSTANDING FOR ARGUMENTATIVE DIALOGUE SYSTEMS IN THE OPINION BUILDING DOMAIN
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical Natural Language Understanding (NLU) components of an argumentative dialogue system, specifically intent classification and argument similarity. While it uses social and potentially moral topics (like marriage and nuclear weapons) as data for evaluating these NLU models, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or ethical/moral reasoning frameworks themselves.
